Free two-page parent resource

Make sense of one big reaction, without trying to solve everything at once

The Big Reactions Quick Check helps you slow one difficult moment down and notice what happened before, during and after.

Get the free Quick Check 2 pages · About 5 minutes

A calm starting point for parents. No diagnosis, scoring or perfect answers.

When the moment feels confusing

You may remember the reaction, but not what led into it.

  • You are replaying the moment and wondering what you missed.
  • Different explanations are making it harder to know where to begin.
  • You want something concrete to bring into a conversation with a partner, teacher or professional.

What you will receive

A fillable guide that keeps the first step manageable

Use it on your phone or computer, or print it. Prompts and examples help you move beyond “it came out of nowhere” without asking you to write a long account.

  • A simple before, during and after structure
  • Examples for when your first answer feels too vague
  • Space to note one possible next step, not a full behaviour plan
Send the guide to my email ↓

How to use it

Five quiet minutes after one recent moment

  1. 1

    Choose one moment

    Pick something recent. You do not need to cover every reaction.

  2. 2

    Write what you noticed

    Short, observable details are enough. The guide gives you examples.

  3. 3

    Look for one clue

    Use it to decide what to observe, discuss or try next.

Safety first: if anyone is unsafe, put the worksheet aside and focus on immediate safety and support.
